scope.newObservation: One ordinary text input_method dump after raw process completion and before one screenshot/fixture cleanup.

recommendedCommand.budgetStatus: Root and host owners froze internal5s/remote8s/host12s; slow IPC remains unknown, no retry or budget extension.
notes: dumpsys option parsing stops at input_method and forwards the two service arguments unchanged.
IMMS parses --user using Arrays.binarySearch; exactly this two-element argument order is supported, do not casually append unsorted service arguments.
No -w, --proto or --dump-priority CRITICAL. A single selected service has no DUMP OF SERVICE wrapper header/footer.
CLI return0 is necessary but insufficient. Internal timeout/read/Binder errors can also exit0.
External timeout matches the prior executed wrapper syntax; no new device syntax probe or toybox exit-code assumption.

timingAssessment.verdict: Acceptable as an explicitly later diagnostic
timingAssessment.benefit: Collection is already frozen and process exited, so dump cannot affect the stored raw callback set or extend the raw deadline.
requiredEvidence: bounded original combined stdout/stderr or separately preserved originals
raw end and screenshot start command order
limits: Host wall-clock intervals do not map the entire remote dump to a single device elapsedRealtime instant.
IMMS captures current binder then dumps client and IME sequentially; selected component, client state and service state are not an atomic cross-process snapshot.
IInputMethodWrapper schedules its dump at front of IME main-thread queue, so it can briefly perturb states observed by the subsequent screenshot.
Timeout/pipe closure does not prove remote system_server or IME work was cancelled; report failure/unknown without retry.

outer: Exactly one Input Method Manager Service state: header.
Exactly one top-level selected UserId=0 block. Do not confuse user-repository/history text with the selected user block.
Within its mBindingController block, unique mSelectedImeId and mCurImeId normalized to configured component; mCurDisplayId=0; mCurIme non-null.
Configured package UID continues to come from existing validated before/after package evidence. InputMethodInfo list UID is installed metadata, not an independently sampled IME process UID.
service: Exactly one Input method service state for <expanded configured service class>@<identity hash>: header, after selected user/current binding context.
Read fields only within that service block, using exact indentation and field grammar. Never choose the first or last global field match.
Require one final base sentinel mBackCallbackRegistered=(true|false), and no second service/current-user section, duplicate required fields or rejection text.
A subclass may omit/override base dump or format. Missing/unsupported expected structure remains unknown, not a fallback to client/history fields.
client: Within IMS mInputEditorInfo subblock, packageName should be dev.agentos.compat for interpreting this synthetic editor. A null EditorInfo is a legitimate negative observation but cannot establish client association.
Optional mInputBinding UID validation compares existing fixture receipt UID, not IME UID. InputBinding UID denotes the client app.
Binder/token object strings and Java hash codes are not the held raw-window Binder identity and must not establish same-window equivalence.
identityContract.strength: Evidence of a configured current IMMS binder choice and corresponding later service-class dump, not atomic component/process/window attestation.

requiredFields: mInputEditorInfo presence and, when nonnull, inputType/packageName
mSettingsObserver hard-keyboard cache or explicit null
fieldSemantics: mViewsCreated is not proof that onCreateInputView returned a non-null view.
mInputViewStarted is callback/start state, mIsInputViewShown is the last visibility decision; neither gives actual input frame height or rendered keys.
Configuration uses keyboard tokens -keyb/qwerty/12key and hidden suffixes /v,/h,/s; preserve unknown values rather than map them to no keyboard.
SettingsObserver cache 0=unknown,1=false,2=true; null/unknown is data, not false.
Last computed Insets are the IMS cached values. VISIBLE mode can have empty touchableRegion normally, because WMS computes the actual region using visible insets.
Keep a bounded raw region representation; parsing it does not make it the final WMS or SF region.
mInputView nullness, actual mInputFrame visibility/heights, WMS final region and SF crop/pre-JNI region remain unobserved.

rejectionRules.interpretation: Any rejection prevents a complete recorded inference. Preserve bounded original bytes and individual available/unknown statuses; do not convert missing/ambiguous values to false or use duplicate fallback. False/null diagnostic states themselves are not retry triggers and do not make raw acceptance pass.

timeoutSources.limitations: Several sequential IPC stages may exhaust the fixed outer budget; this yields a preserved unknown observation instead of extending time or repeating.
